blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095797, the XAUm proxy still resolves to implementation 0x3194e478b6d3ebee969470295f271727b62adf7b. Its verified MToken source exposes operator-only addToBlockedList and removeFromBlockedList. transfer blocks a listed caller; transferFrom blocks a listed caller or sender. Receiving transfers and NFT pack/unpack bypass those checks by design, so this is a scoped outgoing-transfer freeze rather than a universal address lock.

routes.reviewNote: The verified HyperEVM proxy resolves to MTokenSide implementation 0x8a9a4b06a570e59f107859ae1827b17e46567dac.
